$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: Icons convey meaning through shape (trash, magnifying glass, plus), not color alone.
Icons have clear contrast against backgrounds in both light and dark modes.
Icon shapes (trash = delete) visually match their announced names. Icon-only controls are acceptable when the shape is clear.
All icons and size labels (12–40 in Sizes story) are fully visible and readable.
No focused screenshots provided for any story; this criterion does not apply.
